# Wisnu Alfian Nur Ashar — Full-Stack, Cyber Security & AI Engineer

> Portfolio of Wisnu Alfian Nur Ashar, an Information Technology undergraduate at President University (Bekasi, Indonesia). Full-Stack Engineer working across cyber security, AI, software engineering and DevOps. Bilingual site (English / Indonesian) with an interactive 3D "Skill Universe".

## About

- Role: Full-Stack Engineer (Laravel, Next.js, Go, PostgreSQL), penetration-testing practitioner, AI/computer-vision builder
- Location: Bekasi, West Java, Indonesia (open to internships, remote work and freelance)
- Production work: ERP/POS platform for Ashar Grosir Parfum Bekasi serving thousands of customers through the store website (1.34 s load time, 91% good LCP via Cloudflare CDN)
- Open source: 3,300+ GitHub contributions across 100+ repositories; verified bug reports and fixes to NASA, Microsoft, Google, NVIDIA, OWASP and Hugging Face projects
- Security: external and internal penetration testing with structured vulnerability reporting; OWASP Foundation member
